title: [QLD, NSW, VIC] Samsung 65" S85F OLED 4K Smart AI TV (2025) $1645 + Metro Delivery / Depot Pickup @ JB Hi-Fi
body:
Deal: [QLD, NSW, VIC] Samsung 65" S85F OLED 4K Smart AI TV (2025) $1645 + Metro Delivery / Depot Pickup @ JB Hi-Fi

[RichardL] Thanks for confirming, updated deal with the generic code.
[p3r514n] Yeah, I think it has the B6 WOLED panel.
[HaydosK] qd oled is better than woled. its a more premium tech. hard to explain but better colour and uniformity on the screen
[Spector1] it has the B6 WOLED panel, still a good deal though
[justtoreply] That's 10" for free.
I don't think I can handle it.
[Busted Bunker] Realistically how much would you expect the LGs to be around Black Friday? Is this a no-brainer?
[Guzd] So here it’s not a qd oled so hard for reviews. It is relatively dim but we have it in a standard living room and it’s not too bad at all!
[PharmerDan] How does this rate compare to the LG C series OLEDs?
[StingyAussie] LG C series = Samsung S90 series
LG G series = Samsung S95 series
[dec1an] Samsung Vizen suuuucks. Quit trying to push Andrew Bolt and co into my living room…
[imomox3] This or the TCL 65C7L?
Mostly for movies/tv shows and YouTube. Lounge room in an open lit room.
[ReaperX22] The tcl. It'd be significantly brighter. The Samsung probably onty wins at night for your use case. Being WOLED means it's not nearly as bright as the QD oled models.
Miniled is way brighter. If it matters, my mate bought the 75inch C8K and every other day was 'I can't believe it's not OLED' in regards to black levels. His room is bright though not directly sunlit so may give you an idea.
[refocusonme] i was looking for a tv and just pulled the trigger. i think this must be ATL for this ?
[p3r514n] Found a review for the WOLED version: https://www.choose.tv/au/tv/reviews/samsung/samsung-s85f-wol…
